title: BMO launches AI agent to help credit card customers get answers
summary: BMO is introducing AI Agent Assist to help clients get faster answers and resolutions when they contact BMO's Virtual Connect contact centre about their credit card transactions.

title: Simplii Financial: 4.50% HISA promo for 5 months
summary: Simplii offered 4.50% on a high-interest savings account for 5 months (Oct 1 – Jan 31, 2026). Window has closed — included as an example of own-brand tracking.

title: Canada's Big Six banks explore a shared CAD tokenized-deposit system
summary: RBC, TD, BMO, CIBC, Scotiabank and National Bank are jointly studying a Canadian-dollar tokenized-deposit solution, starting with transfers between institutions. Money would be issued by the commercial banks, not a central-bank digital currency. Described as exploratory.

title: Scotiabank: up to 5% savings promo and bundle worth up to $1,000
summary: A Scotia High Interest Savings promo of up to 5% for 3 months, with a Preferred Package + savings + credit card bundle worth up to $1,000. Promo window referenced as ending Oct 29, 2026 — verify current terms.

title: Open banking framework arriving in Canada in 2026
summary: Canada's federal open-banking framework is slated to begin in 2026, enabling consented read-only data sharing and mandating participation from major banks. Verify specifics against the official regulator page.
